law.diktatura.richer_than_king: Thou shalt not be richer than the King
law.diktatura.richer_than_king.desc: If your inventory is worth more than 12800 (Upgrader value): arrest, hard labour and 60 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.protect_villagers.desc: Killing a villager or wandering trader: arrest (hard labour and 60 s in a cell) and −20 loyalty.
law.diktatura.state_property.desc: Breaking the prison, the throne hall, the government offices, the State Casino or their forecourts is forbidden. The action is cancelled, fine: 5 workdays. The rest of the world — break away.
law.diktatura.no_sedition.desc: Calls to overthrow the Leader or insults in chat: arrest, hard labour and 30 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.no_look_up.desc: The sky belongs to the Leader. Looking up causes temporary blindness.
law.diktatura.curfew.desc: Being outdoors at night is forbidden. Fine: 5 workdays.
law.diktatura.no_tall_houses.desc: Buildings taller than three blocks insult the Leader's palace. The block is not placed.
law.diktatura.no_caps.desc: MESSAGES IN CAPS: 30 seconds of silence and heavy feet.
law.diktatura.no_running.desc: Citizens move with dignity. Runners are slowed down.
law.diktatura.no_sneaking.desc: Whoever sneaks is hiding something. Offenders are highlighted for everyone.
law.diktatura.diamonds_belong_to_state.d: Holding diamonds is forbidden: they are confiscated.
law.diktatura.no_explosives.desc: Carrying TNT or end crystals: confiscation and arrest (hard labour and 30 s in a cell).
law.diktatura.silence.desc: Talking in chat is forbidden today. Every message costs a fine.
law.diktatura.golem_is_police: The golem is a police officer
law.diktatura.golem_is_police.desc: Killing an iron golem is assaulting the police. Arrest: hard labour and 45 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.sacred_cow.desc: Cows are under the Leader's protection. Killing one costs 10 workdays and a lightning strike. Cows from the sky are protected too.
law.diktatura.no_chicken_punching: The chicken is a national symbol
law.diktatura.no_chicken_punching.desc: Hitting a chicken insults the nation. The hit is cancelled, 20 seconds of timeout.
law.diktatura.protect_flowers.desc: Picking flowers is forbidden. The flower stays, fine: 5 workdays.
law.diktatura.earth_core_is_secret: The deep is a state secret
law.diktatura.earth_core_is_secret.desc: Going below Y=0 is forbidden. Offenders are pushed back up.
law.diktatura.water_is_state_property.de: Swimming without a permit is forbidden. Offenders are weakened.
law.diktatura.helmet_required.desc: Going out without a helmet is forbidden. Fine: 5 workdays.
law.diktatura.no_pumpkin_masks.desc: Wearing a pumpkin hides you from the police. It will be confiscated.
law.diktatura.hunger_is_banned.desc: The country lives in abundance; being hungry is forbidden.
law.diktatura.no_emigration.desc: Leaving the Overworld (Nether or End): arrest, hard labour and 30 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.sleep_is_laziness.desc: Sleep is a paid service: 5 workdays per attempt to lie down. The lazy also get fatigue.
law.diktatura.carrots_for_the_king.desc: Commoners may not eat carrots. All carrots are seized.
law.diktatura.no_ranged_weapons.desc: Bows, crossbows and tridents are seized when used.
law.diktatura.gold_under_kings_feet: Gold is only for the King's feet
law.diktatura.gold_under_kings_feet.desc: Commoners may not stand on gold blocks.
law.diktatura.no_teleporting.desc: Ender pearls and chorus fruit are seized.
law.diktatura.ore_tax.desc: Every mined ore is taxed 5 workdays.
law.diktatura.keep_off_grass.desc: Breaking grass and dirt spoils the Leader's landscape.
diktatura.punish.warning: This is a warning. The Leader sees everything.
diktatura.punish.fine_unpaid: Fine partly paid (%s of %s × %s). Debt recorded: −%s loyalty.
diktatura.punish.timeout: Timeout for %s s: chat is closed, your feet grow heavy.
diktatura.timeout.muted: You may not speak for another %s s.
diktatura.arrest.broadcast: %s has been arrested: "%s". Hard labour, then %s s in a cell.
diktatura.transport.depart: The express wagon is taking you to hard labour!
diktatura.prison.admitted: Labour accepted. You are in a cell, sentence: %s
diktatura.prison.released: Your sentence is over. The wagon will take you back.
diktatura.prison.home: You are free. Five minutes of leniency, then back under watch.
diktatura.loyalty.reward: The Leader is pleased: 2 emeralds and honour.
diktatura.rebellion.start: REBELLION! The people have lost faith. Laws are suspended for %s min (except the fundamental ones).
diktatura.rebellion.end: The rebellion has been crushed. Order is restored.
diktatura.decree.title: Decree No. %s
diktatura.dictator.say.0: The law is harsh, but it is the law. My law. I made it up yesterday.
diktatura.dictator.say.1: I see everything. Especially you. Yes, and that too.
diktatura.dictator.say.2: You may look at me. Not up, though. Looking at the crown costs extra.
diktatura.dictator.say.3: Wealth is a burden. Let me carry it. All of it.
diktatura.dictator.say.4: Our cells are cosy. Three stars on a travel site!
diktatura.dictator.say.5: My next decree will be brilliant. Like the last one. And the one before that.
diktatura.dictator.say.6: Loyalty is the best currency. No change given.
diktatura.dictator.say.7: Freedom? Is that a new block? Ban it just in case.
diktatura.dictator.info: Laws in force: %s. Your loyalty: %s. Next decree in about %s min.
diktatura.hud.returning: The wagon is taking you home
diktatura.book.title: Book of Laws
diktatura.book.subtitle: Laws in force: %s · next decree in %s
diktatura.minigame.parkour.help: Jump your way to the golden platform. The green platform is a checkpoint; if you fall, you restart there.
diktatura.minigame.quarry.help: Mine %s stone with the issued pickaxe. The stone restores itself and drops nothing.
diktatura.minigame.maze.help: Find the way out of the maze: a gold block in the far corner.
diktatura.minigame.done: Labour complete! Now to your cell.
diktatura.event.amnesty.text: The Leader is merciful! Prisoners released: %s
diktatura.event.gifts.text: Every free citizen receives a gift.
diktatura.event.blind_eye.text: By the Leader's order everyone looks with one eye. %s seconds.
diktatura.event.no_gravity.text: The Leader abolishes gravity! %s times for %s seconds. No fall damage.
diktatura.ui.headline.decree: THE LEADER HAS ISSUED A DECREE
diktatura.ui.headline.decree.sub: Decree No. %s takes effect immediately. Ignorance is no excuse.
diktatura.ui.headline.rebellion.sub: Laws are suspended (%s min). The Leader is displeased.
diktatura.ui.rebellion_end.hint: Laws are back in force. Loyalty has been restored by force.
diktatura.ui.test.alert.hint: Alerts work. A report has been filed.
diktatura.ui.test.danger.hint: Flashes red, as the regulations require.
diktatura.ui.wanted.title: WANTED
diktatura.ui.wanted.sentence: Labour duty, then %s s in a cell
diktatura.ui.loading.title: STATE LOADING
diktatura.npc.dictator.info.rebellion: A rebellion is under way. The Leader is taking names.
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.0: I have signed a new decree. Rejoice in an orderly fashion.
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.1: Attention! The laws have changed. Are you breaking them yet?
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.2: My decree is brilliant. It is not up for discussion.
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.3: Citizens! Read the Book of Laws. That is an order.
diktatura.book.nothing_found: Nothing found. Perhaps it is classified.
diktatura.book.repealed.empty: The Leader has not repealed anything yet. He is always right.
diktatura.book.licenses.empty: No licences. Permission for the forbidden is sold by Comrade Stampov in the government offices north of the throne hall — if he's in.
diktatura.dictator.say.8: I'm not a dictator. I'm just a very confident manager.
diktatura.dictator.say.9: Read the Book of Laws? There's a sequel. Came out today.
diktatura.dictator.say.10: Smile. That's not an order. Actually, it is.
diktatura.dictator.say.11: I was elected unanimously. I voted.
diktatura.npc.generic.info: Open to citizens: 24/7. Lunch break: also 24/7.
diktatura.npc.unknown.say: I work here. As what is classified, even from me.
diktatura.cmd.npc.dictator: The Leader has been checked and seated on the throne.
diktatura.dictator.hit.0: That tickles. Guards, process this citizen.
diktatura.dictator.hit.1: Was that a punch? I thought it was a mosquito. Arrest him. The mosquito too.
diktatura.dictator.hit.2: Ow! I mean... not ow. Leaders don't say ow. Arrest!
diktatura.dictator.hit.3: You hit the state. The state is offended.
diktatura.dictator.hit.4: Noting: "attacked the Leader bare-handed". Brave. Stupid, but brave.
diktatura.cmd.throne_rebuilt: The throne hall has been repaired. The bill has been sent to the people.
diktatura.money.reason.admin: Administrative decision. Not up for discussion
diktatura.money.reset: All workdays reset. The five-year plan starts over.
diktatura.job.already: You already have a job. Two jobs is careerism
diktatura.job.courier.start: Deliver the parcel to %s, %s. Deadline: %s min. The recipient is waiting and nervous.
diktatura.job.builder.start: Build right in front of you: green sparks show missing blocks. Deadline: %s min, can be handed in from %s%% accuracy.
diktatura.job.done.pay: %s workdays credited. The Motherland is proud (moderately).
diktatura.job.late.paid: Time's up. For the work done: %s workdays.
diktatura.job.failed.arrest: Job "%s" was ruined by your arrest. No pay, no sympathy.
diktatura.job.builder.far: The building site is too far — get closer
diktatura.job.builder.need: At least %s%% required. That's not a gazebo, it's a crime against architecture.
diktatura.job.choose: Vacancies (choosing is free, quitting is not):
diktatura.job.recipient.yours: This is your recipient. He has waited. For a long time.
diktatura.job.recipient.not_yours: Waiting for a parcel, but not from you.
diktatura.job.none: No job. Idleness isn't banned yet. Yet.
npc.diktatura.employer.say.0: There's always work. Pay depends on the Leader's mood.
npc.diktatura.employer.say.1: No CV needed. We already know everything about you.
npc.diktatura.employer.say.2: A workday is like a day, only with more work.
npc.diktatura.employer.say.3: Experience? Doesn't matter. Quitting experience costs three workdays.
npc.diktatura.employer.say.4: Today's special: you work, you get paid. No promises for tomorrow.
npc.diktatura.employer.say.5: Unemployment has been defeated. By decree.
npc.diktatura.recipient.say.0: I'm waiting for a parcel. Not yours. Someone else is waiting for yours.
npc.diktatura.recipient.say.1: Been standing here since morning. The state said wait, so I wait.
npc.diktatura.recipient.say.2: Not a courier? Then step aside, you're blocking the horizon.
npc.diktatura.recipient.say.3: What's in the parcel? No idea. But I can't wait.
npc.diktatura.recipient.waiting: Finally! Is that for me? Hurry up, I've been here since morning.
npc.diktatura.recipient.no_parcel: Where's the parcel? Without a parcel you're just a person who walked into a field.
npc.diktatura.recipient.thanks: Thank you! What is it? Never mind — if the state sent it, I must need it.
diktatura.cmd.npc.employer: The exchange clerk is in place and already bored.
law.diktatura.state_property_build.desc: Placing blocks in the prison, the throne hall or their forecourts is forbidden. There is only one architect, and he is on the throne.
license.diktatura.mining.desc: Mine ore tax-free, hold diamonds and dig down to the Earth's core. The core is still classified, but you know people.
license.diktatura.portal.desc: Visiting the Nether and the End is allowed. No need to declare souvenirs (yet).
license.diktatura.night.desc: You may walk after curfew. The Moon has been notified.
license.diktatura.voice.desc: Talking in chat is allowed, even IN CAPS. Your opinion still doesn't count.
license.diktatura.garden.desc: You may touch grass and pick flowers. The flowers object, but nobody asked them.
license.diktatura.sport.desc: Running and sneaking are allowed. Olympics not guaranteed.
license.diktatura.water.desc: You may swim in state water. Splashing is at your own risk.
license.diktatura.astronomy.desc: Looking up is allowed. Nothing interesting up there, but now it's legal.
npc.diktatura.licensor.say.0: Everything is forbidden. But for workdays — permitted.
npc.diktatura.licensor.say.1: Without a permit you're nobody. With a permit you're nobody with a permit.
npc.diktatura.licensor.say.2: A breathing licence is still free. Still.
npc.diktatura.licensor.say.3: The stamp is free. So is the signature. The permission is not.
npc.diktatura.licensor.say.4: Get arrested and we take the licence. Nothing personal, just regulations.
diktatura.license.confirm.line: Are you sure? Think it over. I'll wait. I'm paid to wait.
diktatura.license.confirm.terms: Price: %s workdays · term: %s game days (1 day = 20 minutes)
diktatura.license.confirm.extend: You already have it — the term will be added to what's left.
diktatura.license.no_money.hint: %s needed. The Labour Exchange is next door, if Comrade Staffov is in.
diktatura.license.bought.hint: Valid for %s game days. See Book of Laws → "My licences".
diktatura.license.expired.hint: The law applies again. Renew with Comrade Stampov.
diktatura.license.revoked_arrest: Licences cancelled on arrest: %s. The papers burned, and so did the sympathy.
diktatura.office.leave.0: That's it, lunch time. The next lunch starts right after this one.
diktatura.office.leave.1: The working day is over. It was intense: a whole two minutes.
diktatura.office.leave.2: I'm off to a meeting. With myself.
diktatura.office.leave.3: Stepping out for a bit. "A bit" is a flexible concept.
diktatura.office.open.hint: %s is open for ~%s min. Hurry before he changes his mind.
diktatura.office.closed.hint: %s is closed. Back when he's back.
diktatura.office.status.closed: %s: closed, promised to be back in ~%s min (roughly)
diktatura.cmd.office.rebuilt: The government offices have been repaired. The officials didn't notice.
npc.diktatura.croupier.say.0: Place your bets! The state has already placed its own.
npc.diktatura.croupier.say.1: The casino is open 24/7. The only institution that actually works.
npc.diktatura.croupier.say.2: Our odds are honest: honestly rigged.
npc.diktatura.croupier.say.3: Winnings are taxed. Losses aren't. See how generous we are?
npc.diktatura.croupier.say.4: Luck is a state resource. We're lending it to you briefly.
npc.diktatura.croupier.say.5: Gambling isn't a vice. Winning too often is.
diktatura.casino.info.limit: Bets left this hour: %s of %s · winnings tax %s%%
diktatura.casino.win: %s. Won: %s wd (tax of %s wd already withheld)
diktatura.casino.lose: %s. Your %s wd bet went to state needs
diktatura.casino.win.title: Won: +%s workdays
diktatura.casino.win.tax: Tax of %s wd withheld. Thank you for contributing.
diktatura.casino.big.hint: The Leader congratulates. And is already looking into such luck.
diktatura.casino.no.arrested: Prisoners can't gamble. In a cell you can only bet your time.
diktatura.casino.no.limit: The limit is %s bets an hour. The state cares about your wallet. A little.
diktatura.casino.no.money: The bet is %s wd and you have less. We don't give loans — we give jobs.
diktatura.casino.no.law: By the Leader's decree, gambling requires a gambling licence.
diktatura.casino.quip.win.0: Congratulations. That was a mistake, we'll take note.
diktatura.casino.quip.win.1: Whoa. Let me check the wheel isn't broken.
diktatura.casino.quip.win.2: A win! The tax inspector is already smiling.
diktatura.casino.quip.win.3: Enjoy it. Statistics will fix this soon.
diktatura.casino.quip.lose.1: All by the rules. Our rules.
diktatura.casino.quip.lose.2: Your contribution to the economy is priceless. We priced it anyway.
diktatura.casino.quip.lose.3: One more? The odds are improving. No, they're not.
diktatura.cmd.casino.rebuilt: The State Casino has been repaired. The wheel has been re-rigged.
law.diktatura.no_gambling.desc: Playing at the State Casino without a gambling licence is forbidden. The bet is refused, loyalty −3.
license.diktatura.gambling.desc: You may lose workdays at the State Casino even when the Leader objects. Winning is still not recommended.
diktatura.punish.fine_debt: Fine: %s workdays. No money — recorded as debt (balance %s). The state will wait. Not for long.
npc.diktatura.tax_inspector.say.0: Good afternoon. Still good, for now.
npc.diktatura.tax_inspector.say.1: Scheduled inspection. The schedule is: everyone.
npc.diktatura.tax_inspector.say.3: I won't be long. Exactly thirteen percent.
npc.diktatura.courier.say.0: Parcel for you! What's inside? No idea, I just carry them.
npc.diktatura.courier.say.1: Express delivery! Express means whenever I remembered.
npc.diktatura.courier.say.2: Sign here. Just kidding, signing is not allowed.
npc.diktatura.courier.say.3: A parcel from the state. Non-returnable.
diktatura.visit.tax.coming.hint: A tax receipt in your inventory saves you from an inspection
diktatura.visit.courier.coming.hint: State Post is bringing a mystery parcel
diktatura.visit.tax.take.0: Thirteen percent: %s workdays. Thank you for choosing our tax office. There is no other.
diktatura.visit.tax.take.1: Collecting %s workdays. Don't worry, it goes to a good cause — me.
diktatura.visit.tax.take.2: %s workdays to the treasury. A receipt? Maybe. If you're lucky.
diktatura.visit.tax.empty: Empty? Well, I'll note that you tried. Actually, I won't.
diktatura.visit.tax.receipt: You have a receipt? Fine, you're free. I'm taking the receipt — it's single-use.
diktatura.visit.tax.receipt.title: Inspection passed
diktatura.visit.tax.receipt.hint: Tax receipt taken. No tax collected.
diktatura.visit.tax.got_receipt: The inspector issued a tax receipt: it will save you from the next inspection.
diktatura.visit.tax.hit: Assault on the tax office! Calling the bailiffs!
diktatura.visit.courier.give: Here! And don't shake it — anything could be inside.
diktatura.visit.courier.got.hint: Right-click the parcel to open it. At your own risk
diktatura.parcel.money.msg: Workdays in the parcel. The state is generous sometimes. Sometimes.
diktatura.parcel.diamond.msg: Diamonds in the parcel. We won't check your mining licence. Today.
diktatura.parcel.bread.msg: Bread in the parcel. Humanitarian aid from the Leader.
diktatura.parcel.chickens.msg: Ten chickens in the parcel. How they fit is a state secret.
diktatura.parcel.anvil.msg: An anvil in the parcel. It's already falling. Look up!
diktatura.parcel.portrait.msg: A portrait of the Leader. Loyalty +5. Hang it somewhere visible.
diktatura.parcel.confetti.msg: Confetti in the parcel. A celebration you didn't order.
diktatura.parcel.receipt.msg: A tax receipt in the parcel. The most valuable thing you'll ever find in one.
diktatura.weather.speaker: Meteorologist Cloudov
diktatura.weather.cows.voice: Attention! Precipitation in the form of cows is expected. Not everyone got a parachute.
diktatura.weather.anvils.hint: A red mark shows where one will land. Look up
diktatura.weather.anvils.voice: The weather office reports: scattered anvils. An umbrella won't help.
diktatura.weather.aid.hint: Bread is falling from the sky. Catch it — the Leader's treat
diktatura.weather.aid.voice: The Leader cares about you: precipitation in the form of bread. Thanks accepted in the throne hall.
diktatura.radio.speaker: State Radio Announcer
diktatura.radio.0: This year's harvest is 300%% above last year's. Last year's harvest is classified.
diktatura.radio.1: Reminder: looking up requires an astronomy licence.
diktatura.radio.2: Unemployment is defeated! Comrade Staffov awaits you. Sometimes.
diktatura.radio.3: The Leader smiled today. A good sign. For the Leader.
diktatura.radio.4: Rumours that the State Casino is rigged are true. We're proud of it.
diktatura.radio.5: Tomorrow's weather: sunny, with scattered cows.
diktatura.radio.6: Citizens, check the Book of Laws. A new decree came out while you were listening. Probably.
diktatura.radio.7: The tax office is on high alert today. Tomorrow too. Always.
diktatura.radio.8: A happy citizen is a loyal citizen. A loyal citizen is a free citizen. For now.
diktatura.radio.9: We continue our broadcast. Ad break in 13 seconds. Or sooner.
diktatura.ad.timer: Ad ends in %s s · the game is not paused
diktatura.ad.0.title: STATE CASINO
diktatura.ad.0.text: Win up to 30 workdays per bet! The odds are honestly rigged. Winnings tax — only 13%%.
diktatura.ad.0.fine: Ad approved by the Ministry of Finance. The Ministry gets a cut.
diktatura.ad.1.title: LICENCE TO LOOK UP
diktatura.ad.1.text: The sky exists! See for yourself for just 5 workdays. Comrade Stampov awaits (sometimes).
diktatura.ad.1.fine: Clouds not guaranteed. Looking at the Sun requires a separate licence.
diktatura.ad.2.title: WORK AT THE EXCHANGE
diktatura.ad.2.text: Courier, cleaner, miner, builder, lumberjack! Pick any job. Quitting costs only 3 workdays.
diktatura.ad.2.fine: Comrade Staffov is in sometimes. Possibly.
diktatura.ad.3.title: WORKDAYS
diktatura.ad.3.text: Not lost on death! Not confiscated! Only the tax office, the law and the casino can take them. That's all.
diktatura.ad.3.fine: The workday-to-emerald rate is a state secret.
diktatura.ad.4.title: THE LEADER CARES
diktatura.ad.4.text: Humanitarian aid falls from the sky! Sometimes cows. And anvils. But mostly care.
diktatura.ad.4.fine: The weather office is not liable for bruises.
diktatura.ad.5.title: STATE POST
diktatura.ad.5.text: We deliver anything, to anyone, whenever we remember! A mystery parcel for every citizen.
diktatura.ad.5.fine: Parcel contents may fall on your head.
diktatura.timber.title: TIMBER!
diktatura.timber.hint: The whole tree came down: %s logs. Sneak to chop one at a time
diktatura.cavein.title: CAVE-IN!
diktatura.cavein.hint: The ceiling is crumbling — move away! A mining licence cuts the risk fourfold
diktatura.cold.start.hint: Sneezing in public may be forbidden. Cure: state tea
diktatura.cold.over: The cold passed on its own. The state had nothing to do with it
diktatura.tea.healthy: You're already healthy. But the tea is nice
diktatura.eraser.used.hint: The chancellery eraser wiped the protocol. There was no arrest. Nor an eraser
diktatura.eraser.bought.hint: Keep it in your inventory: it erases one arrest protocol
diktatura.slipper.crit.0: "I told you to put your hat on!"
diktatura.parcel.tea.msg: State tea in the parcel. The state cares about your health (and its taxes).
diktatura.parcel.eraser.msg: A chancellery eraser in the parcel! It erases one arrest protocol. Don't lose it.
npc.diktatura.customs.say.1: What are we carrying? Doesn't matter, we'll seize it anyway.
npc.diktatura.customs.say.2: The border is wherever I'm standing.
npc.diktatura.customs.say.3: Any imports? And if I find some?
diktatura.visit.customs.coming.hint: Imports from the Nether and the End will be seized. The geese are on their way
diktatura.visit.customs.import: Imports found: %s pcs. Seized for the state. The geese confirm.
diktatura.visit.customs.taken.hint: Goods from the Nether and the End can't be brought in duty-free
diktatura.visit.customs.duty: No imports? Suspicious. Duty for the absence of imports: %s.
diktatura.visit.customs.duty.title: Customs duty
diktatura.visit.customs.nothing: Empty pockets. The geese are disappointed.
diktatura.visit.customs.hit: Assault on customs! Geese, attack! And call the bailiffs!
law.diktatura.forest_duty.desc: Trees are felled only by state order: with a lumberjack job or a forest licence. Otherwise a 3-workday fine.
law.diktatura.public_sneezing.desc: Sneeze near other citizens — a 2-workday fine and 15 seconds in a cell. Be ill at home.
license.diktatura.forest.desc: You may fell trees outside state orders. The tree will still come down whole — not our department.
diktatura.goose.stole.hint: %s — catch the thief before it gets away
diktatura.captcha.title: Citizenship Verification Bureau
diktatura.captcha.ask: Prove you are not a robot. Select every cell with:
diktatura.captcha.ok.hint: You may use this block freely for a minute
diktatura.captcha.fail.hint: The Bureau tests robots with lightning
item.diktatura.strange_mushroom.lore1: Very filling. Not approved by the Ministry of Health
diktatura.double.arrived.hint: The Oversight Bureau sent an agent. Go home — or detain it
diktatura.trip.hint: Strange mushroom. The Ministry warned you
diktatura.trip.disabled: Filling. Nothing strange: the substance is banned by the Ministry of Health
diktatura.dragon.intro.sub: The Leader's personal guard. Doesn't check passes
diktatura.dragon.att.roar.hint: Raise your shield or step away from the edge!
diktatura.dragon.att.dive.hint: Leave the red circle and jump over the wave
diktatura.dragon.att.meteor.hint: Get out of the big red circle
diktatura.dragon.att.gravity.hint: You're about to fly. Stay away from the edge
diktatura.finale.guard_down.sub: The State Guard Dragon is down. The Leader is unprotected — hit him, if you dare
diktatura.finale.start.sub: He got up from the throne. This will take a while
diktatura.finale.bar.draw: Leader of the Peoples — declaring a draw
diktatura.finale.phase2.sub: …cancelled for lack of stamps. The Leader is just angry
diktatura.finale.decree.no_hurry.say: Decree: no hurrying in my presence!
diktatura.finale.decree.no_looking: Looking at the Leader without permission is prohibited
diktatura.finale.decree.no_weapons: Hitting the Leader at full strength is prohibited
diktatura.finale.decree.no_weapons.say: Decree: hit the Leader at half strength only!
diktatura.finale.decree.dance.say: Now everybody dances! That's an order!
diktatura.finale.say.start: The guard is on holiday? Fine. I'll guard myself!
diktatura.finale.say.phase2: You ruined my uniform. Now it's personal!
diktatura.finale.say.propaganda: ATTENTION ALL! One minute of propaganda!
diktatura.finale.say.leave: Everyone ran off? Then I'm off to a meeting.
diktatura.finale.say.draw1: I declare a draw. In my favour, naturally.
diktatura.finale.say.draw2: The brave get a medal and a holiday from the law. Don't thank me.
diktatura.finale.taunt.1: Write it down: fell in the attempt.
diktatura.finale.taunt.2: So noted — a draw in my favour.
diktatura.finale.retreat: THE LEADER LEFT FOR A MEETING
diktatura.finale.retreat.hint: Still no guard — you can challenge him again
diktatura.finale.draw.sub: The Leader declared victory. Participants are decorated
diktatura.finale.award: ORDER "FOR A DRAW WITH THE LEADER"
diktatura.finale.award.hint: +50 workdays, and laws don't apply to you for %s game days
diktatura.money.reason.draw: Bonus for a draw with the Leader
item.diktatura.order: Order "For a Draw with the Leader"
item.diktatura.order.lore1: Awarded by the Leader himself. Through gritted teeth
item.diktatura.order.lore2: The bearer is temporarily above the law
diktatura.dragon.att.sentence.hint: Your legs are shackled — crawl out of the red circle before lightning strikes
diktatura.dragon.att.mines.hint: The crystals explode in three seconds — run
diktatura.dragon.att.witnesses.hint: Endermen came to witness the violation
diktatura.dragon.att.transfer.hint: You have been reassigned to another part of the island
diktatura.finale.cannon.hint: State Guard weapons won't fire at the Leader. Fight fair
diktatura.finale.cannon.0: The Dragonslayer is for dragons! Do I look like a dragon?
diktatura.finale.cannon.1: State property doesn't work against the Leader. Read the manual!
diktatura.finale.confiscated.hint: %s flew aside — pick it up before it's too late
diktatura.finale.say.busts: Busts of the Leader — onto the citizens' heads!
diktatura.finale.say.decoys: The decree on multiplying the Leader takes effect!
diktatura.finale.say.tax: As of this second, every hit is taxed!
diktatura.finale.tax.sub: For 6 seconds every hit on the Leader costs %s workdays
diktatura.money.reason.assault_tax: Tax on attempting to harm the Leader
diktatura.finale.say.speech: Comrades! My report will take only five hours…
diktatura.finale.speech.sub: Listeners wilt, the Leader heals. Interrupt him!
diktatura.cmd.finale.no_dragon: Needs a living dragon in the End and at least one player there
diktatura.cmd.finale.guard_down: Guard removed: hitting the Leader now starts the final fight
diktatura.cmd.finale.running: The final fight is already on
diktatura.cmd.finale.no_npc: The Leader isn't on the throne (throne hall not built or chunk not loaded)
diktatura.cmd.finale.stopped: Final fight stopped, the Leader is back on the throne
diktatura.cmd.finale.reset: The guard is back: beat the dragon to fight the Leader
diktatura.bloodmoon.start.sub: Night of popular wrath: laws are suspended until dawn. Twice the mobs, no sleeping
diktatura.bloodmoon.end.sub: Laws are back in force. Survivors get %s workdays for resilience
diktatura.money.reason.bloodmoon: For resilience during the Blood Moon
diktatura.cmd.bloodmoon.running: The Blood Moon is already on
diktatura.cmd.bloodmoon.not_running: There is no Blood Moon right now
npc.diktatura.slots_operator.say.0: The "Five-Year Plan" machine. You pull the lever — the state pulls you.
npc.diktatura.slots_operator.say.1: Three stars is the jackpot. Three tractors is nice too, just rarer.
npc.diktatura.slots_operator.say.2: I tuned the reels personally. Honestly.
npc.diktatura.slots_operator.say.3: Don't bang on the machine: it holds grudges.
npc.diktatura.slots_operator.say.4: Moustache, wheat, stamp — the classic losing combo.
npc.diktatura.dice_croupier.say.0: Two dice for you, two for the state. Higher total wins.
npc.diktatura.dice_croupier.say.1: A tie goes to the house. It's in the rules. In small print.
npc.diktatura.dice_croupier.say.2: Our dice are natural. We don't discuss their origin.
npc.diktatura.dice_croupier.say.3: I throw because you're not allowed to.
npc.diktatura.dice_croupier.say.4: Sixes come up on schedule. The schedule is classified.
diktatura.casino.info.dice: Your two dice vs the house's two: official %s%%, actual %s%% (×%s). Ties go to the house
diktatura.casino.info.busy: Table busy: a game is on
diktatura.casino.no.busy: The table is busy, wait for the round to end.
diktatura.casino.start.croupier: Bets are placed, no more bets!
diktatura.casino.start.dice_croupier: Throwing! Watch my hands. Actually, don't.
diktatura.casino.lose.title: −%s WORKDAYS
